cli.intro: open-ssl — certificate generation and management. Non-interactive CLI for agents and humans.

cmd.capabilities: Report domain capabilities and their availability
cmd.audit: Read audit records for the current actor
cmd.gui: Open the VMZ GUI window and pump host events until it closes
cmd.certificate-inspect: Parse and display an X.509 certificate
cmd.certificate-issue: Issue a certificate from a CA
cmd.certificate-renew: Renew a certificate with an idempotent policy
cmd.certificate-revoke: Revoke a certificate and publish a CRL
cmd.ca-create: Create or update a root or intermediate CA
cmd.csr-create: Build and validate a certificate signing request
cmd.private-key-store: Generate, protect, import, or export a private key
cmd.certificate-store: Enumerate or manage certificates in the local store
cmd.remote-agent: Manage certificates on a remote computer
cmd.host-install: Install the host integration and desktop entry
cmd.host-uninstall: Remove the host integration and clean residual state
cmd.acme-plan: Report the local-only issuance plan: `open-ssl acme-plan <domain...>`; provider and zone come from `open-ssl.json`
cmd.acme-issue: Issue and deliver a certificate: `open-ssl acme-issue <domain...>`; provider, zone, and directory come from `open-ssl.json`, flags override

opt.actor: Audit actor id (user or agent name)
opt.dry-run: Plan only, do not touch host state
opt.kind: Filter audit records by actor kind
opt.id: Filter audit records by actor id
opt.capability: Filter audit records by capability id
opt.from-ms: Filter audit records from this Unix timestamp in milliseconds
opt.to-ms: Filter audit records up to this Unix timestamp in milliseconds
opt.content-dir: Directory containing the staged GUI build
opt.acme-kind: Override the `kind` configured in `open-ssl.json`: staging or production
opt.dns-provider: Override the `dnsProvider` configured in `open-ssl.json`: cloudflare or manual (default: config, then manual)
opt.identifier: Domain to certify; pass them as plain arguments instead
opt.contact: Override the account contacts configured in `open-ssl.json`; repeatable
opt.project: Project root owning .secrets/open-ssl.json (defaults to the working directory)
opt.dns-ready: With `manual`: records are already placed, print the guidance without waiting on stdin
